definitions.gloss: striking first; taking the lead; scoring first
definitions.explanation: Getting the first point or the first blow in before the opponent, above all in sports; in {先制攻撃|せんせいこうげき} also a pre-emptive military strike.

examples.japanese: {先制|せんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}した→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{先制|せんせい}した。
examples.english: Japan took the lead in the first half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{先制点|せんせいてん}→先制点：08585_senseiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{挙|あ}げて、そのまま{逃|に}げ⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: They scored first in the first inning and held on to win.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{先制点|せんせいてん}→先制点：08585_senseiten⟧: the opening goal or run
- {先制|せんせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to score first, to take the lead
- {先制|せんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: to let the opponent score first
- {先制攻撃|せんせいこうげき}: a pre-emptive attack or strike

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先手|せんて}→先手：10556_sente⟧: the first move (in board games, negotiations) — {先制|せんせい} is used above all for scoring first in a match.

WATCH OUT:
Homophones: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ (teacher), ⟦{宣誓|せんせい}→宣誓：12312_sensei⟧ (oath), ⟦{専制|せんせい}→専制：17739_sensei⟧ (autocracy).
